name: qgis-rs-py
description: Bun/Turbo facade for the qgis-rs Python distribution. `build` is the whole maturin story: `maturin develop --release` (installs into pixi's default environment and puts the extension next to the mixed-layout Python sources pytest imports) plus `maturin build --release` for the shippable wheel, from one compilation. `test` and `coverage` therefore only run pytest, and CI needs no separate maturin or virtualenv step.
